001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.net.URI;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
007import dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
008import dev.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
009import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * A base implementation of a node item for a Metaschema definition that exists
015 * without a parent context (orphaned).
016 *
017 * @param <D>
018 *          the Java type of the definition
019 * @param <I>
020 *          the Java type of the instance
021 */
022public abstract class AbstractOrphanedDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance>
023    extends AbstractDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
024
025  @Nullable
026  private final URI baseUri;
027  @NonNull
028  private final StaticContext staticContext;
029
030  /**
031   * Construct a new orphaned definition node item.
032   *
033   * @param definition
034   *          the Metaschema definition this node represents
035   * @param baseUri
036   *          the base URI for resolving relative references, or {@code null} if
037   *          not applicable
038   */
039  public AbstractOrphanedDefinitionNodeItem(
040      @NonNull D definition,
041      @Nullable URI baseUri) {
042    super(definition);
043    this.baseUri = baseUri;
044    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder();
045
046    builder.defaultModelNamespace(ObjectUtils.notNull(definition.getQName().getNamespace()));
047
048    if (baseUri != null) {
049      builder.baseUri(baseUri);
050    }
051
052    this.staticContext = builder.build();
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public INodeItem getParentNodeItem() {
057    // no parent
058    return null;
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public URI getBaseUri() {
063    return baseUri;
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public StaticContext getStaticContext() {
068    return staticContext;
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  protected String getValueSignature() {
073    return null;
074  }
075}
